snippet.title: Toaplan Arcade 4 - Evercade Cartridge Tour
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS. This is not only one of the last carts for 2024, but also the final Toaplan cartridge for Evercade.

Games in this cart:
00:18 - Dogyuun
03:06 - Grind Stormer
05:18 - Knuckle Bash
14:54 - Pipi & Bibi's
25:46 - Sky Shark (NES version of Flying Shark)
28:02 - Snow Bros. 2

Toaplan and all included titles (C) Tatsujin [Part of Embracer Freemode]
